_comment: 1.9 Seasons. A shared 28-day year of four 7-day seasons counted from `epoch` (a Monday) by calendar date, so every player sees the same season on the same date and nothing needs saving. Day 7 of each season (Sunday) is the festival (1.9 festivals). `yearRound` crops grow in every season. Every other crop lists the seasons it can be PLANTED in (a crop already planted keeps growing when the season ends). A seasonal crop planted in season grows `bonus.growMult` as long and gains `bonus.silver` / `bonus.gold` quality chance. Every season keeps at least 12 crops open (checked by validate-data).

spring.name: Spring
spring.blurb: Blossom and new growth. Berries, peas and lavender come into their own.

summer.name: Summer
summer.blurb: Long bright days. Sugarcane, melons and tomatoes love the heat.

autumn.name: Autumn
autumn.blurb: Golden leaves and full barns. Pumpkins, beets and onions are ready.

winter.name: Winter
winter.blurb: Quiet and frosty. Hardy roots and greens still grow, and the greenhouse ignores the cold.
